name: Omascratch
author: weedwhitesandwine
description: A quick-note scratchpad that docks to a screen corner. Toggle with a keybind or the bar icon; font size, corner, and the keybind itself are all configurable from an in-panel settings view. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.weedwhitesandwine.omascratch

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Omascratch note scratchpad

schema.label: Show the icon in the bar (the keybind works either way)
